Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert incorrectly identified the last line of the rhyme on the background headstone. In Step 3, the expert stated that the background headstone in the photo of "Dastardly Mash" is "Crème Brulee" and quoted the last line from the Crème Brulee headstone ("So it may not be beaucoup too late to save Crème Brulee from beyond the grave."). This is a hallucination. The text provided in Step 2 explicitly shows that the photo for "Dastardly Mash" (1979-1991) has the rhyme: "*Here the brazen / DASTARDLY lies. / Some say that raisin, / Caused its demise.*". The last line of *this* rhyme is "Caused its demise." The expert failed to read the text associated with the Dastardly Mash entry and instead arbitrarily selected the rhyme from a different flavor (Crème Brulee) appearing elsewhere in the list, failing the core instruction to find the rhyme on the headstone visible in the background of the *oldest* flavor's (Dastardly Mash) photo.
